about: The starter spell list (docs/briefs/spell-list.md #2781, spec docs/specs/combat/spell-slots.md): one row per spell a new mage meets, over levels 1-10. `id` is an existing spell-index.json id at the brief's (root, level); `name` is the display name; nothing else lives here (cost, school and share come from the index and brick rows). Ids picked by Combat from the existing catalogue (already-vetted legends) by theme fit at each (root, level); Strategy signs off before the rows PR merges (legends rule).
